company.description: Repaymi is a fintech and accounts receivable automation company that provides AI-powered invoice collection and payment recovery solutions for businesses. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in London with operations in Dubai, the company focuses on helping SMBs, freelancers, and invoice-heavy organizations improve cash flow management and reduce manual debt collection efforts.
